title: Risk Stratification in Myeloma: Defining Precision in the Genomic Era.

title: An anoikis-related four-gene prognostic signature and functional characterization of ANXA5 in laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies of the head and neck region.
